description: Clean-room ERP transactional core (SAP S/4HANA class): double-entry general ledger with multi-currency and period close, perpetual inventory with batch/moving-average valuation, and MRP (BOM explosion, netting, planned orders). Judged almost entirely without tolerances: transactional invariants must hold after every posting, and the trial balance, valuation layers and MRP plan must match a reference implementation exactly, in integer minor units and whole pieces.
source: hidden transaction journals; references from an independent reference implementation, all quantities exact integers
